title: feat(nm2oricyclrdy): neighbor-read of cyclic lex-largest Orient at t+1 on two-axis opposite y-probes: reverse fails, face fails
science: opposite y-probes, neighbour-read of the cyclic lex-largest orientation. Holds at A and C but fails at B and D, so both pairs fail - the neighbour-read wrapper destroys the reverse HOLD that the bare orientation letter reports at this cell under the other tie-break (#7455).
